options.name: --retention-period-days
options.help: The retention period setting, specified in days.

commands.help: Returns all the audit events processed for the specified compartment within the specified time range.

options.name: --skip-deserialization
options.help: Skips deserializing service response into python sdk response models and returns as plain JSON object.

options.name: --stream-output
options.help: Print output to stdout as it is fetched so the full response is not stored in memory.

options.name: --start-time
options.help: Returns events that were processed at or after this start date and time, expressed in [RFC 3339] timestamp format.

options.name: --end-time
options.help: Returns events that were processed before this end date and time, expressed in [RFC 3339] timestamp format.
